channel.title: Food Service Director - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Food Service Director (foodservicedirector.com)

item.title: Dear Advice Guy, how do I poach perfect eggs by the hundred?
item.description: In this month's edition, Advice Guy tackles one of brunch's biggest problems: poached eggs at high volume neither overdone nor underdone, with just-set whites and runny yolks.

item.title: Federal bill would expand free and reduced-price school meal access for military families
item.description: Also in this week’s K-12 legislative update: Tennessee lawmakers scrutinize ultra-processed food in school meals, a bill in Idaho would ban artificial sweetners in school meals, a Utah lawmaker wants to dedicate more of the state’s liquor tax toward funding free school meals, a bill in Virginia would provide free school breakfast to all students, and New York Governor Kathy Hochul wants to continue the state’s universal free school meals program for another year.

item.title: Moongate Café gallops into the Year of the Horse with art-inspired cuisine
item.description: The new Restaurant Associates-managed café at Washington, D.C.’s Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art has a menu that mirrors the exhibits throughout the year.

item.title: Autumn & Eve Butter-Washed Cocktail
item.description: This bourbon-based cocktail from Chef Jen Biesty for the California Milk Advisory Board is a great way to try the brown butter trend in a glass. Fig puree and maple simple syrup sweeten the deal.

item.title: Recipe report: Brown butter, Volume 1: The sweeter side
item.description: Nutty, toasty, buttery, subtle and so rich; we're keeping the saute pan on for this luxurious trend, taking the sweet route first, featuring brown butter-washed bourbon, brown butter cookies, s'mores dessert bowls and more.

item.title: Brown Butter S’mores Dessert Bowl
item.description: In this 'newstalgic' recipe from Spiceology, brown butter gives the good ol' campfire s'more a depth of flavor never seen before, combined with kettle corn, chocolate chips and gooey marshmallows.

item.title: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
item.description: It's tough to imagine the beloved chocolate chip cookie could get even better, but you'll have to taste this recipe from McCormick for Chefs.

item.title: Apple Brown Butter Crumble with Caramel Sauce
item.description: Brown butter's sweeter side really sings with backing flavors of gingersnap, zesty orange and cinnamon in this recipe from California Milk Advisory Board.

item.title: Brown Butter Crispy Treats
item.description: Sweet, nutty brown butter flavor is the elevated twist on this nostalgic classic dessert from McCormick, making it double impossible to resist.

item.title: Aramark SeniorLIFE+ heats up winter with Great Soup-Off Competition
item.description: The competition tasked Aramark SeniorLIFE+ chefs at five Asbury Communities in the Northeast with creating a soup recipe that reflected their “background, expertise or culinary curiosity,” according to the foodservice provider.
